claim_scope: RSC Advances 2015 review states MoS2 has three known polytypes - 1T, 2H, and 3R - distinguished by the coordination of Mo and by layer stacking (2H and 3R: trigonal-prismatic; 1T: octahedral). Secondary-scholarly framework establishing the polytype distinction.

locator.verbatim: three known polytypes - namely 1T, 2H, and 3R - of MoS2 ... 2H and 3R commonly have trigonal prismatic coordination (D3h) of molybdenum atoms, but they have different stacking order.

governance_note: ADMITTED (secondary_scholarly) via QUAL-RSC-MOS2-REVIEW-001 for 'mos2_polytype_framework'. Establishes the 1T/2H/3R distinction (Claim B polytype scope). Separate atomic record from the layered evidence. Contract-C=(not_public,noindex).
